items.information: ### Please note there will only be 2 rounds of 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and no 3x3x3 Cube. Competitors may bring a maximum of 1 guest. [Bali Discovery Speedcubing Masters 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BaliDiscoveryMasters2024) will be held on the weekend following this competition. **Important** In accordance with articles [2g](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2g), [2k](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k), and [2l](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l), competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA Regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate.

items.information: Välkomna till Vännäs & Friends 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Vännäs & Friends 2024 Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
